nodes.Name: EncodedLen
nodes.DocComment:
EncodedLen returns the length of an encoding of n source bytes.
Specifically, it returns n * 2.

nodes.Name: Encode
nodes.DocComment:
Encode encodes src into [EncodedLen](len(src))
bytes of dst. As a convenience, it returns the number
of bytes written to dst, but this value is always [EncodedLen](len(src)).
Encode implements hexadecimal encoding.

nodes.Name: AppendEncode
nodes.DocComment:
AppendEncode appends the hexadecimally encoded src to dst
and returns the extended buffer.

nodes.Name: ErrLength
nodes.DocComment:
ErrLength reports an attempt to decode an odd-length input
using [Decode] or [DecodeString].
The stream-based Decoder returns [io.ErrUnexpectedEOF] instead of ErrLength.

nodes.Name: InvalidByteError
nodes.DocComment: InvalidByteError values describe errors resulting from an invalid byte in a hex string.

nodes.Name: DecodedLen
nodes.DocComment:
DecodedLen returns the length of a decoding of x source bytes.
Specifically, it returns x / 2.

nodes.Name: Decode
nodes.DocComment:
Decode decodes src into [DecodedLen](len(src)) bytes,
returning the actual number of bytes written to dst.

Decode expects that src contains only hexadecimal
characters and that src has even length.
If the input is malformed, Decode returns the number
of bytes decoded before the error.

nodes.Name: AppendDecode
nodes.DocComment:
AppendDecode appends the hexadecimally decoded src to dst
and returns the extended buffer.
If the input is malformed, it returns the partially decoded src and an error.

nodes.Name: EncodeToString
nodes.DocComment: EncodeToString returns the hexadecimal encoding of src.

nodes.Name: DecodeString
nodes.DocComment:
DecodeString returns the bytes represented by the hexadecimal string s.

DecodeString expects that src contains only hexadecimal
characters and that src has even length.
If the input is malformed, DecodeString returns
the bytes decoded before the error.

nodes.Name: Dump
nodes.DocComment:
Dump returns a string that contains a hex dump of the given data. The format
of the hex dump matches the output of `hexdump -C` on the command line.

nodes.Name: bufferSize
nodes.DocComment: bufferSize is the number of hexadecimal characters to buffer in encoder and decoder.

nodes.Name: NewEncoder
nodes.DocComment: NewEncoder returns an [io.Writer] that writes lowercase hexadecimal characters to w.

nodes.Name: NewDecoder
nodes.DocComment:
NewDecoder returns an [io.Reader] that decodes hexadecimal characters from r.
NewDecoder expects that r contain only an even number of hexadecimal characters.

nodes.Name: Dumper
nodes.DocComment:
Dumper returns a [io.WriteCloser] that writes a hex dump of all written data to
w. The format of the dump matches the output of `hexdump -C` on the command
line.

Fields.Name: used
Fields.DocComment: number of bytes in the current line
